lines: 先看一个荒唐的比喻：每招一个岗位，就重办一所大学。
A job opening, and we build a whole university for it.
2017 年之前，自然语言处理差不多就是这样。
Before 2017, natural language processing mostly looked like that.
每个任务收一份标注数据，训一个模型，只解决这一件事。
One labelled set, one model, one task, and nothing more.
换任务就得重训，学到的语言知识一点也带不走。
Change the task, retrain, and none of the language knowledge follows.
标注还是最贵的一环：一条数据要人读、人判、人填。
Labels cost the most: a human reads, judges and fills each one in.
这一章讲：怎么绕开标注，先读书，再做题。
This chapter: skip the labels, read first, then do the exercises.
所以瓶颈不在模型，而在数据：标注太贵了。
So the bottleneck is not the model. It is the labels.
几万条标注听着不少，其实只够一个很窄的任务。
Tens of thousands of labels still cover only one narrow task.
任务一换，这份数据就作废，模型也要跟着重训。
Switch the task and the data is dead; the model is retrained.
情感分析、命名实体、问答、翻译，各要一套。
Sentiment, entities, question answering, translation: one set each.
但另一边，无标注的文本是取之不尽的。
Meanwhile, unlabelled text never runs out.
互联网上有几万亿 token，它们本身就是答案。
Trillions of tokens on the web are already their own answers.

scenes.en: LET THE TEXT SET THE QUIZ
lines: 自监督的想法很朴素：从文本里挖掉一部分。
Self-supervision starts simply: remove part of a text.
让模型去补，补对了算对，补错了就改参数。
Let the model fill it back; right answers keep it, wrong ones move weights.
因为原文就是标准答案，一个标注工都不用请。
The original text is the answer key, so no labeller is ever hired.
这一招有两个版本，分歧决定了后来五年的走向。
Two versions emerged, and their split shaped the next five years.
版本 A 是自回归：给定前面的词，预测下一个词。
Version A is autoregressive: given the words before, predict the next.
这就是第 1 章的语言模型目标，一字未改。
That is the language model objective from Chapter 1, unchanged.
它天然从左到右，只能看见已经写出来的部分。
It reads left to right, seeing only what has already been written.
版本 B 是掩码：随机挖掉句子里百分之十五的词。
Version B is masking: hide fifteen percent of the words at random.
让模型根据左右两边，把它们填回原来的位置。
The model fills them back using both sides of the sentence.
这叫掩码语言模型，本质上是一道完形填空题。
This is the masked language model, a cloze test at scale.
两条路线看的方向不同，训练信号也不同。
The two routes differ in what they see and what trains them.
自回归只看左边，每个位置都要预测下一个词。
Autoregression sees only the left, and predicts at every position.
掩码左右都看，但只有百分之十五的位置有信号。
Masking sees both sides, but only fifteen percent of positions signal.
2018 年 6 月，OpenAI 的 GPT-1 给出了完整配方。
In June 2018, OpenAI's GPT-1 published a complete recipe.
第一步，生成式预训练：十二层 Transformer 解码器。
Step one, generative pre-training: a twelve-layer Transformer decoder.
约一点一七亿参数，在七千本未出版的书上做下一词预测。
About 117 million parameters, predicting the next word in 7000 books.
第二步，判别式微调：接一个小分类头，用少量标注数据。
Step two, discriminative fine-tuning: a small head and a little labelled data.
在蕴含、问答、情感分类这些任务上，分别微调一遍。
Entailment, question answering, sentiment: one pass of tuning each.
十二个任务里，有九个刷新了当时的纪录。
It beat the record on nine of twelve tasks.
更重要的是它证明：语言知识是可以迁移的。
More important, it showed that language knowledge can be transferred.
四个月后，2018 年 10 月，Google 的 BERT 登场。
Four months later, in October 2018, Google's BERT arrived.
结构换成编码器，没有因果掩码，可以看全句。
The structure is an encoder, no causal mask, so it sees the whole sentence.
目标有两个：挖掉百分之十五的词来填，再判断两句是否连续。
Two goals: fill in fifteen percent of words, and tell if two sentences connect.
数据是书籍语料加英文维基百科，约三十三亿词。
Training data: book corpus plus English Wikipedia, about 3.3 billion words.
Base 一点一亿参数，Large 三点四亿参数。
Base has 110 million parameters; Large has 340 million.
它在十一个自然语言处理任务上全面刷新了最好成绩。
It set a new state of the art on eleven NLP tasks.

scenes.en: STRONG AT READING, WEAK AT WRITING
lines: 双向的好处，在理解类任务上表现得最明显。
The gain from both directions shows up in understanding tasks.
判断 bank 是河岸还是银行，左右两边都用得上。
Telling river bank from money bank uses words on both sides.
被训练成一台上下文填空机，它自然擅长分类和抽取。
Trained as a context-filling machine, it is good at classification and extraction.
但它的训练目标和生成不匹配，这是个结构性缺陷。
But its objective does not match generation. That is a structural flaw.
它见过的是被挖了洞的句子，擅长填空，不擅长写文章。
It has only seen sentences with holes: good at filling, bad at writing.
你可以用它做分类，但不能拿它来聊天。
You can classify with it, but you cannot chat with it.
一条路线擅长理解，另一条路线擅长生成。
One route is strong at reading, the other at writing.
2019 年 2 月，OpenAI 发布 GPT-2，十五亿参数。
In February 2019, OpenAI released GPT-2 with 1.5 billion parameters.
大约是 GPT-1 的十三倍，数据是四十 GB 的网页文本。
About thirteen times GPT-1, trained on 40 GB of web text.
论文标题说：语言模型是无监督的多任务学习器。
The paper's title: language models are unsupervised multitask learners.
意思是，训练数据里本来就有翻译、问答、摘要和代码。
The training text already holds translation, QA, summaries and code.
一个足够大的模型，可能没针对任何任务训练过。
A large enough model may never have been trained on any task.
把任务写成一段提示，让它接着写，这叫零样本。
Write the task as a prompt and let it continue. That is zero-shot.
不改架构，不加任务头，续写这一个接口吃掉所有任务。
Same architecture, no task head: one interface eats all tasks.
这个两段式，可以用一个古老的教育模型来理解。
This two-stage recipe maps onto an old model of education.
预训练像通识教育，学语言的一般规律和世界知识。
Pre-training is liberal arts: general patterns of language and the world.
数据海量、无标注、便宜，目标是学会世界如何运转。
Data is huge, unlabelled and cheap; the goal is how the world works.
微调像职业培训，学具体任务的输入输出格式。
Fine-tuning is vocational training: the input-output format of one job.
数据少量、有标注、很贵，目标是学会这个岗位怎么做。
Data is small, labelled and costly; the goal is how this job is done.
通用机床加专用夹具，也比每个零件造一台机床便宜。
A general machine tool plus a jig beats one machine per part.
类比失效的地方在于：通识毕业并不能直接上岗。
The analogy breaks where a graduate still cannot start the job.
但模型足够大时，提示里给几个例子就能现学，微调被跳过。
But a big enough model learns from examples in the prompt, skipping tuning.
到 2019 年底，BERT 如日中天，GPT-2 只是有趣。
By late 2019 BERT was dominant and GPT-2 merely interesting.
但从 2020 年起，天平彻底倒向自回归这一边。
From 2020 on, the balance tipped fully to autoregression.
第一个原因：接口统一，任何任务都能写成给上文、续写。
First reason: one interface. Any task is context in, continuation out.
分类、翻译、写代码、做数学题，都是同一句话。
Classification, translation, code, maths: all the same sentence.
而填空的接口，很难覆盖生成类的任务。
A fill-in-the-blank interface struggles to cover generation.
第二个原因：可扩展，自回归每个位置都有训练信号。
Second reason: scalability. Autoregression signals at every position.
掩码只有百分之十五的位置有信号，数据利用率差近七倍。
Masking signals only fifteen percent, nearly seven times less use of data.
第三个原因：规模一大，通用目标开始逼出任务能力。
Third reason: at scale, the general objective forces out task ability.
预训练不是免费的午餐，它带来三个新问题。
Pre-training is not a free lunch. It brings three new problems.
第一，数据截止：模型只知道截止日期前的世界。
First, knowledge cutoff: it knows only the world before its data ends.
第二，分布偏移：语料是平均的互联网，你的任务可能很窄。
Second, distribution shift: the corpus is the average web, your task narrow.
第三，无法追溯：很难知道某个事实是从哪段文本学来的。
Third, no provenance: you cannot tell which text taught it a fact.
这既是版权问题，也是模型的可解释性问题。
That is both a copyright problem and an explainability problem.
模型足够大时，微调会变得不必要，范式转向提示。
When models get big enough, tuning fades and the paradigm turns to prompts.
把三次发布排成一条线，转向就看清楚了。
Line up the three releases and the turn becomes visible.
2018 年 6 月，GPT-1 把预训练和微调接了起来。
June 2018: GPT-1 joined pre-training to fine-tuning.
同年 10 月，BERT 用双向掩码在理解任务上全面领先。
October 2018: BERT led on understanding with bidirectional masking.
2019 年 2 月，GPT-2 押注零样本，当时并不起眼。
February 2019: GPT-2 bet on zero-shot, and looked unremarkable.
监督的瓶颈是标注，自监督用文本自身绕开了它。
Supervision was bottlenecked by labels; self-supervision used the text.
预训练加微调，等于通识加职业培训，知识可以迁移。
Pre-train then fine-tune: liberal arts then vocational, knowledge transfers.
胜负手不是谁更聪明，而是谁更容易规模化。
The winner was not the smarter one, but the one easier to scale.
这一章留下的问题很直接：规模一大，能力为什么冒出来。
The question left open is direct: why does ability appear as scale grows?
GPT-2 之后，OpenAI 把同样的配方放大了约一百倍。
After GPT-2, OpenAI scaled the same recipe about a hundredfold.
结果不只是更好，还出现了没人训练过的能力。
The result was not just better: abilities nobody trained appeared.
下一章讲规模定律，以及它划出的边界。
Next chapter: scaling laws, and the limits they draw.
先读书，再做题；下一步，是把书读得更大。
Read first, then practise. Next, read on a much larger scale.
